subject: Changes we need before signing the Services Agreement
body:
Dear Awan Biru Pte Ltd,

We have read the draft and can go ahead once a few points are settled:

- Clause 5.1 (page 2): make the liability cap mutual, at 12 months of fees.
- Clause 5.2 (page 2): raise your own cap from one month to 12 months of fees.
- Clause 6.1 (page 2): shorten the renewal notice period to 30 days.
- Clause 9.1 (page 3): change the governing law to the laws of Malaysia.
- A new clause on personal data handling and breach notification.

Could you send a revised draft?

Kind regards,
Kedai Contoh Sdn Bhd
